title: Stop Paying for Domains You Forgot
summary: Keep one list of every domain, its renewal date and what it costs, so you renew what you use and let go of what you do not.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you hold domains you no longer use; the value is fees avoided and fewer surprise renewals, not new income.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You stop paying for domains that no longer serve the business.
Renewals stop catching you by surprise.
who_its_for: Owners who hold domains from old projects.
Agencies that manage domains for several clients.

outputs: One domain list with renewal dates

steps: Connect the registrar in read-only mode.
Mark each domain as keep, park or release.
Review the renewal list each month.
Approve any renewal or release yourself at the registrar.
guardrails: Nothing is renewed, released or changed without your approval.
Check auto-renew settings at the registrar before a domain is released.
